outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 40–103, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its side and interior (frames 136–156, image and left_ego_image). The drawer remains visibly open after the gripper releases the handle (frames 181–196, image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other side effect is visibly established.
